facts.heading: DDR5-4800 U-DIMM Memory Module
facts.module_configuration_note: The ordering table places exact MPN AD5U480016G-DT on the 16GB Dual Tray row; interpreting Dual Tray as a two-module 2x16GB package remains a human-review caveat.
facts.ecc_classification_note: The datasheet states on-die error correcting code; this is not treated as system-visible ECC. UDIMM supports the unregistered/unbuffered classification pending human acceptance.
